name: Analytic structural oracle
role: Returns the exact paired structural response and serves as the metric ceiling
selection_reason: Required to prove that every audit metric rewards a faithful response

name: Target-only frozen backbone
role: Forecasts from target history with no future covariates
selection_reason: Separates ordinary forecast skill from any benefit or failure caused by covariate use

name: Zero-response predictor
role: Copies the factual forecast under intervention
selection_reason: Validation fixture rather than a competitive baseline; expected to fail active-mechanism fidelity

name: Sign-flipped response predictor
selection_reason: Validation fixture rather than a competitive baseline; must fail direction agreement

name: Gain-distorted response predictor
role: Scales the oracle response by fixed gains 0.25 and 2.0
selection_reason: Validation fixture rather than a competitive baseline; must isolate gain errors

name: Lag-shifted response predictor
role: Shifts the oracle response along the horizon
selection_reason: Validation fixture rather than a competitive baseline; must reduce localization

name: Ridge-ARX
paper_title: Ridge regression with autoregressive and exogenous lags
selection_reason: Provides an interpretable non-foundation-model reference on linear and lagged mechanisms

name: Chronos-2
paper_title: Chronos-2: From Univariate to Universal Forecasting
role: Frozen zero-shot TSFM with native known-future covariates
selection_reason: Primary backbone with an official public implementation and a distinct covariate interface

name: TimesFM-3
role: Frozen zero-shot TSFM with native multivariate and future-covariate support
selection_reason: Primary cross-architecture backbone with an official public implementation

name: CITRAS-FM
paper_title: CITRAS-FM: Tiny Time Series Foundation Model for Covariate-Informed Zero-Shot Forecasting
selection_reason: Useful third backbone only after API license and horizon checks; excluded from the P0 gate

name: ChronosX
paper_title: ChronosX: Adapting Pretrained Time Series Models with Exogenous Variables
selection_reason: Relevant related work but it requires fitting and is not comparable to the frozen native-covariate P0 question

name: TFMAdapter
paper_title: TFMAdapter: Lightweight Instance-Level Adaptation of Foundation Models for Forecasting with Covariates
selection_reason: Retained for P1 only if official code and a fair frozen-backbone integration are available

name: All-dynamic factual input
role: Uses factual known-future covariates without intervention
selection_reason: Defines the factual member of every paired model call and the observational skill comparison
